text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the exhibition race.<n>Shinko Windy is
being interviewed at<n>the TV studio.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! ♪ I'm so strong, I'm gonna<n>make today's
win look easy!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Spoken like the true favorite! That<n>confidence is
infectious. So, who do<n>you see as your biggest
rival?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Dunno! And who cares about theother racers, ask another questionabout me!

text_block_list.name: Celebrity A
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Confidence like hers is hard<n>to find! Kids
these days never toot<n>their own horn. She's a real
breath of<n>fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I know what you mean!<n>Let's see...
Second in the popularity<n>rankings is Yamato Marin!
She's<n>showing a ton of potential as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the studio bit wraps up, we<n>head to the
racecourse, and the race<n>begins!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Go! Race your heart out! Windy!<n>We're rooting for
you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (Ngh! ...How? How's she so fast?!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Shinko Windy makes a beautiful<n>cut and breaks
out of the pack! Can<n>she take the lead in time?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (I'm closing in! Just gotta go faster!<n>Faster!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: H-huh? Huff... Puff... N-no!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (Why can't I pass her?! I'm... so...<n>close!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(No way... This isn't right... I'm<n>supposed to win!
I'm the strongest<n>one here!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (No... No! No! No! No! I have to win... IHAVE to!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(I did all that training... every day, from<n>dawn till
dusk!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(I promised myself I'd win! That I'd<n>take the first
step towards achieving<n>my ambition!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(But if I lose now... I might as well<n>kiss my
hundred-years dream<n>goodbye!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Who's in front?! You've got this!<n>Keep going! Go!
Go! Go! Go for the<n>win, Yamato Marin!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shaddup! The only name you<n>should be
yelling is MINE!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: RAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: CHOMP!

text_block_list.name: Yamato Marin
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Yamato Marin starts speeding ahead<n>completely
out of the blue! Huh? Wait,<n>what just happened?
Was she<n>bitten?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamato Marin keeps the lead all the<n>way to the
finish line. Leaning over to<n>bite her made Shinko
Windy lose her<n>balance and finish in second place.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Well folks, this is a first... We're<n>currently checking
over the footage...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After some tense deliberation, the<n>official verdict is
that Shinko Windy's<n>actions did not count as an
obstruction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as the bite left no injury on<n>Yamato Marin
and in fact directly led<n>to her victory, it couldn't be
defined<n>as "behavior that grants an unfair
advantage."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy isn't punished or<n>disqualified, but
she's given a stern<n>warning.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You've got to be kidding me! What<n>was she
thinking? She'd have won if<n>she kept her teeth to
herself.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: B-but... I-I...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
News of her biting Yamato Marin<n>spreads
throughout Japan almost<n>instantaneously.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see the news about<n>Shinko Windy?
Isn't that crazy?<n>Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
It's no laughing matter. I knew she<n>wasn't the
most serious athlete, but<n>my word... what did she
think was<n>going to happen?

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
Violent behavior during a race is<n>completely
unacceptable. Are they<n>being strict enough with
their students<n>over there at the academy?

text_block_list.name: Internet Comments
text_block_list.text:
"It's cause she has all that energy..."<n>"Yamato
Marin lucked out! lololol"<n>"Think Shinko Bitey would
chomp<n>me?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Biting in a race is dangerous.<n>Someone could
trip and fall...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after the race, I give Shinko<n>Windy a stern
lecture about her<n>behavior. She does appear to be
sorry... but at the same time falls
uncharacteristically quiet.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Excuse us, dearies. I hope you don't<n>mind us
paying a visit.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy! We saw you on the news.<n>What in the
world were you doing?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I got annoyed, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Listen, we all get angry from time to<n>time, but that
doesn't mean you can<n>go around biting people.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No duh... I know that already...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Well, I hope you've learned your<n>lesson.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we're kinda busy here, so<n>would you scram
already?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer and I gotta go buy a box of<n>sweets so I can
apologize.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, okay!
choice_data_list:
Sorry about that, but would you mind coming back
another time?

Sorry about that, but would you mind coming back
another time?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That won't be a problem. We're<n>sorry for causing
you delay.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, do keep a close eye on her<n>for me, will
you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: We'll do what we can as well, okay?
choice_data_list: Thanks for looking out for her, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Think nothing of it. We dirt runnerslook after our own. And after all, thatis all we can do for her right now.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy did a bad thing, but... she...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that day, we meet up with the<n>other
Umamusume involved in the<n>incident and her trainer
in a hotel<n>lounge and apologize again.

text_block_list.name: Yamato Marin
text_block_list.text:
Th-this wasn't necessary! I'm not<n>hurt at all, and I
won first place<n>because of it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lowering my head, I glance at Shinko<n>Windy. In her
own way, she does<n>look like she's trying, but...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh.

text_block_list.name: Yamato Marin
text_block_list.text:
Um... Are you doing okay, Windy? The<n>media hasn't
been very kind to you...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, thank you very much! A big<n>bad like me
can take this type of heat<n>any day!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But, um...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I shouldn't have bit you on the<n>racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I just got so pissed off 'cause I<n>couldn't pass you,
and I... lost<n>control...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It was dangerous, and it messed up<n>the whole race,
so...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may not be the most eloquent of<n>deliveries, but
she manages to<n>apologize with her own words.

text_block_list.name: Yamato Marin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... for opening up so much.<n>If there's
ever a chance, let's race<n>again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: She's way too nice...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I put you in a tough spot too,<n>didn't I,
Lackey?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I don't get how she can be that<n>strong and so nice
at the same time...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
She must've put in just as many<n>laps as I did
during training, if not<n>more.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile... the only thing going<n>through my head
was...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How ticked off I was that I couldn't<n>win... and I just
exploded. I didn't<n>know how to handle it...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it comes from her overly<n>competitive
personality. It shows just<n>how strongly she wanted
to win.
choice_data_list:
As long as you learn from this experience, I'm sure
things will work out.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Obviously...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll never bite anyone during a race<n>again.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... pinkie swear. A true villain<n>keeps her
promises.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Biting only happens off the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she can learn to control herself, this<n>incident
won't happen again. It's my<n>job to provide her
guidance so she<n>can do just that.
choice_data_list: All right, then... It's time to change gears!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Next time... I'mma run like the<n>wind and win
fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time to get to work training for<n>our next goal,
the Unicorn Stakes!
